📚 The Companies Building Tokenized Finance

• Large asset managers have led adoption in tokenized money market funds and Treasuries, the largest RWA category by assets today.

• Major banks have focused tokenization pilots on collateral mobility, repo settlement and interbank payments.

• Specialized infrastructure companies, distinct from banks and asset managers, supply much of the underlying issuance and custody technology.
